title: Reporting Exclamations: Rules — Quiz 140A
content:
## Reporting Exclamations: Rules

Learn how reporting verbs, that and statement word order are used with exclamations.

### Lesson focus

1. The players said, “Hurrah! We have won the match.”
2. The players exclaimed with joy that they had won the match.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
